blocks.title: Catalyst aur catalysis
blocks.text: Catalyst woh madda hai jo kimiyai reaction ki rate badalta hai magar reaction ke aakhir mein kimiyai taur par be-tabdeel rehta hai; yeh aksar bohat kam miqdar mein maujood hota hai. Catalyst ki maujoodgi mein hone wala amal catalysis kehlata hai.

H2 aur O2 se pani banne ki reaction aam darja hararat par bohat sust hai magar platinum ki maujoodgi mein tez chalti hai; KClO3 thore se MnO2 ke saath kahin tez toot-ta hai; aur HCl CuCl2 ki maujoodgi mein Cl2 mein oxidise hota hai. Catalyst kam activation energy rukawat wala naya reaction rasta deta hai, to zyada molecules nayi rukawat paar kar sakte hain aur rate barhti hai.

items: Homogeneous catalysis: catalyst aur reactants ek hi phase mein hain aur system poore taur par yaksan hai, catalyst yaksan phaila hua. Contact process mein 2SO2(g) + O2(g) se 2SO3(g) NO(g) catalyst ke saath, sab gases; esters H2SO4 ki maujoodgi mein hydrolyse hote hain, CH3COOCH2CH3 + H2O se CH3COOH + CH3CH2OH, sab solution mein.

Heterogeneous catalysis: catalyst aur reactants mukhtalif phases mein hain, zyada tar solid catalyst gaseous ya liquid reactants ke saath. Ammonia platinum gauze par 800 degrees C par NO mein oxidise hoti hai, 4NH3 + 5O2 se 4NO + 6H2O, nitric acid ka rasta; unsaturated organic compounds bareek Ni, Pd ya Pt par hydrogenate hote hain, C2H4 + H2 se C2H6 nickel par 150 degrees C par.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain
blocks.text: Enzymes, qudrat ke catalysts, aam taur par proteins hain; yeh biochemical reactions ki activation energy ghata kar unhen tez karte hain, aur un ki sargarmi pH, darja hararat aur substrate concentration par munhasir hai. Vitamins biochemical reactions mein catalysts ka kaam karte hain, khas kar coenzymes ke taur par jo enzymes ko kaam karne mein madad dete hain; maslan vitamin K khoon jamne ke liye zaroori hai, aur vitamin ki kami cofactor ki kami hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya catalyst reaction mein kharch ho sakta hai? Kya 2SO2(g) + O2(g) se 2SO3(g) NO(g) ke saath homogeneous ya heterogeneous catalysis hai? Uncatalysed aur enzyme-catalysed reaction ka energy profile bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi: tareef se catalyst aakhir mein kimiyai taur par be-tabdeel hai, agarche woh darmiyani qadmon mein hissa le kar dobara ban sakta hai. Gaseous reactants aur gaseous catalyst ke saath contact process homogeneous catalysis hai. Dono profiles ek hi reactant satah se shuru ho kar ek hi product satah par ek hi delta H ke saath khatam hote hain, magar enzyme-catalysed raste ka ubhar, activation energy, uncatalysed se kahin neecha hai.

items: Catalyst rate badalta hai magar aakhir mein be-tabdeel rehta hai, kam Ea wala naya rasta de kar (H2 + O2 ke liye Pt, KClO3 ke liye MnO2, HCl oxidation ke liye CuCl2).

Homogeneous: ek hi phase (contact process mein NO, ester hydrolysis mein H2SO4); heterogeneous: mukhtalif phases (NH3 oxidation ke liye Pt gauze, hydrogenation ke liye Ni); enzymes aur vitamin coenzymes hayatiyati catalysts hain.
